title: Improve volumetric lighting and emissive glow proxies
abstract: ## Summary - Wire Light2D/Light3D volumetric flags into screenspace shafts and froxel scene-light integration; add `volumetricOnly` emissive proxies (C++ / EveScript / editor / example). - Improve shaft/raymarch/fog quality (dual-lobe scatter, soft shadows, dithering, anisotropy packing) with matching SPIR-V and WGSL. - Address Qodo review (proxy ranking before `maxLights`, Camera2D world→screen, Additive multipass, frustum AABB for pending proxies, bounds validation, raymarch correctness). - Clear Source-quality `fallback-contract-inventory` growth by rewording comment-line "fallback" hits. ## Test plan - [x] `PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/check_quality_metadata.py` — fallback inventory back to baseline 71 - [x] Volumetric unit tests (prior push) including froxel ranking / occlusion alias checks - [ ] CI Source quality + Linux after this push

cited_by.name: Volumetric Light Scattering via Froxel Clustering
